interface: GPIO22 relay (NPN low-side driver, active HIGH), GPIO21 active buzzer; BLE observer (scans, never advertises)
note: PROVISIONAL card claiming the next free id (18) for firmware repo IEEE-BLP-RelayActuator. Unlike cards 1-17 this is a COMMAND frame: the gateway (or nRF Connect on a phone) advertises it and the node scans for it. The node transmits nothing, so no readings of this type ever reach the store; relay state is confirmed only on the node's serial log. A new seq = a new command (the sender repeats one command many times per second; the node ignores repeats of the last seq). A command asking for the state the relay is already in is accepted without a beep. The relay always powers up OFF; state is not persisted.
indication: fixed-length beep per relay state change: ON = 1 beep, OFF = 2 beeps (200 ms each, 150 ms gap)
failure_modes: no reaction to a command: wrong kit_id / type / schema, or the same seq as the previous command (treated as a repeat); change seq for every new command
relay_state other than 0 or 1: frame rejected, node logs a warning
single command lost in the air: the sender must repeat the advert for a few seconds; the node does not acknowledge, so a missed command is invisible to the gateway
node reboot: relay returns to OFF regardless of the last command
mounting: relay contacts on the J2 terminal block (NC/COM/NO), rated 12 A / 250 VAC, 15 A / 24 VDC; mains wiring by a qualified person only
